Bug_Details:
Missing method call for verify(mock) here Calls to Mockito.when should always be accompanied by a call to a method like
thenReturn. when(mock.get()).thenReturn(answer); // correct
when(mock.get())                     // oops! when(mock.get()).thenReturn(answer); // correct
when(mock.get())                     // oops! Similarly, calls to Mockito.verify should call the verified method outside
the call to verify. verify(mock).execute(); // correct
verify(mock.execute()); // oops! verify(mock).execute(); // correct
verify(mock.execute()); // oops! For more information, see the Mockito documentation.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates improper usage of Mockito by calling mockMethod() directly instead of using Mockito's thenReturn() after when() and using mockMethod() inside verify(). However, Mockito is not imported or used, so these calls are simulated manually.
